camel_example: aliyun cas ListCert --region cn-hangzhou --Status ISSUE --CurrentPage 1 --KeyWord test_name --SourceType aliyun --CertType CERT --ShowSize 50 --WarehouseId 12 --Identifiers 'aaa,bbb'
description_en: This API queries certificates in the certificate store
description_zh: 本接口一般用于查询证书仓库中的证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-cert --key-word test_name --warehouse-id 12 --status ISSUE --source-type aliyun --cert-type CERT --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --identifiers aaa,bbb --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCert

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search by name, domain name, or subject alternative name
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字。支持通过名称、域名、SANS模糊查询
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The warehouse ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/453246.html API
parameters.name: warehouse_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate status. Valid values:

ISSUE: issued

REVOKE: revoked
parameters.help_zh:
证书状态，取值：

ISSUE： 已签发
REVOKE： 吊销
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The source of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书来源，取值：

upload：上传证书
aliyun：阿里云证书
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

CA: CA certificate

CERT: issued certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书的类型 。取值：

CA：表示CA证书。
CERT：表示签发的证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The default value is 1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页，每页展示数据大小，默认50条
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of certificate identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识，多个标识之间英文逗号间隔
parameters.name: identifiers
